sanskrit: kuśītaṃ kuṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ śaivaṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam candanāgarukarpūra tatmālajala kuṃkumam || kuṣṭaṃ rakta candatam jaṭāmāṃsī surabhirtiviṣṇorgandhāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam svarūpa candane cora rocanāguru meva ca gaṃdhāṣṭakaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ gaṇeśasya maheśituḥ jaṭāmāṃsī kapiyutā śaktyai gandhāṣṭakaṃ viduḥ silūkaḥ kapijodhūmraḥ turuṣkaḥ piṇḍikaviḥ || 7 || silājit || vāmatastu tathā dhūpamagrevāna tu dikṣiṇe nivaraṃ dakṣṇekarṇe vāmecaivaṃ tathādyacchat māyāmṛtyu mahāpāśādvitirmuktosmi śivosmiti śrīkāntiputrāyurvalā rogyaṃ sadā stute
